column2: 中古英语 park ← 古法语 parc（畜栏）← 中世纪拉丁语 parcus ← 法兰克语 *parruk（围栏）
column3: an enclosed public area of grass and trees, or to leave a vehicle somewhere
column5: Children play in the park every afternoon.|He parked the van behind the shop.
column6: an enclosed space set aside – 圈出来专作某用的一片地
column7: 公园：围起来供人游憩的绿地|停车：把车放进圈出的位置
column8: 围起来的一片草地上有长椅和树，入口栏杆边排着几辆车

column2: 中古英语 parlement ← 盎格鲁诺曼语 parliament 与古法语 parlement（商议、集会），由 parler（说话）＋ -ment 构成
column3: the elected assembly that makes the laws of a country
column5: Parliament votes on the bill next week.|She was elected to parliament last spring.
column6: an assembly that meets to speak and decide – 聚起来商议并作决定的会体
column8: 半圆形阶梯座席上众人举手表决，中央有人执槌

column2: 中古英语 passed，是 passen（经过）的过去分词
column3: the time before now, or by the side of something
column5: She rarely talks about the past.|He walked past without a word.
column6: what has already gone by – 已经过去了的那一段
column7: 过去：已流逝的那段时间|经过：从某物旁边通过
column8: 日历一叠已撕下的页散在桌角，墙上只剩当月那张

column2: 中古英语 paste ← 古法语 paste ← 晚期拉丁语 pasta ← 希腊语 pasta（撒盐的大麦糊）
column3: a soft moist mixture, or to stick something onto a surface
column5: She spread paste along the paper edge.|Copy the text and paste it here.
column6: a soft mixture used to stick – 用来粘合的软糊
column7: 粘贴：靠糊状物把一物贴到另一物上|糊状物：软而黏的混合物
column8: 白色黏稠物从管口挤出，抹在纸背后压上墙面

column2: 早期作 passtime／pass-time，来自中古英语 passe tyme，仿中古法语 passetemps 而造
column3: an activity done regularly for enjoyment
column5: Fishing remains his favourite pastime.|Chess was a common pastime then.
column6: something done to pass the time pleasantly – 用来把时间打发过去的事
column8: 桌上摊着拼图，旁边茶杯已凉，窗外天色渐暗

column2: 中古英语 pasture ← 古法语 pasture ← 晚期拉丁语 pāstūra（牧放），源自拉丁语 pāscere（放牧）
column3: land covered with grass where animals feed
column5: Cattle grazed in the upper pasture.|They moved the sheep to fresh pasture.
column6: grassland where animals are put to feed – 供牲畜取食的草地
column8: 缓坡上牛群低头吃草，木栅栏一直延到山脚

column2: 中古英语 pat（一击）← 古英语 plætt（响亮的一掌），中间的 l 脱落；← 原始日耳曼语 *plat-（击打）
column3: to touch someone lightly with a flat hand
column5: She patted the dog on its head.|He gave the boy a friendly pat.
column6: a light flat touch – 用平掌轻轻一触
column8: 手掌张平，在肩上轻轻落下两下就抬起

column2: 中古英语 pacche，词源不明；或为更早 placche（布块）的变体 ← 古英语 *plæċċ（斑点、块）
column3: a small piece of cloth used to cover a hole, or a small area
column5: She sewed a patch onto the sleeve.|A patch of ice covered the path.
column6: a small piece covering or marking an area – 盖住或标出一小片的那块东西
column7: 补丁：缝上去盖住破处的布块|小块地：地面上一小片区域
column8: 破洞上缝着一块颜色略深的布，针脚绕成方形

column2: 中古英语 patent（授予权利的文书），是 lettre patent（公开文书）的截短 ← 中古法语 patente ← 拉丁语 patēns（敞开的）
column3: an official right to be the only one making a new invention
column5: They filed a patent for the new valve.|The patent expires in three years.
column6: an open letter granting an exclusive right – 公开颁发的独占权文书
column8: 盖章文件上画着装置图样，右下角写着编号与日期

column2: 古英语 pæþ（小径）← 原始西日耳曼语 *paþ ← 原始日耳曼语 *paþaz
column3: a narrow way made for walking
column5: A narrow path led down to the river.|They followed the path through the woods.
column6: a narrow way worn by passing – 走出来的一条窄道
column7: 道路：供人行走的窄道|路径：从一处到另一处所循的走法
column8: 林间被踩出一条窄窄的土带，两侧草长得高

column2: 法语 patriotique ← 晚期拉丁语 patriōticus ← 希腊语 patriōtikos，源自 patriōtēs（同乡、同胞）
column3: showing strong devotion to the homeland
column5: Patriotic songs filled the crowded square.|He wrote a patriotic poem for the day.
column6: devoted to the land one belongs to – 对本土怀有深切感情的
column8: 人群在旗下齐声唱着同一首曲子，手按在胸前

column2: 借自法语 patrouille ← 古法语 patouiller（在水里踩踏），源自 patte（脚掌）← 俗拉丁语 *patta ← 法兰克语 *patta
column3: a regular walk or drive around an area to watch it
column5: Guards patrol the perimeter every two hours.|A patrol passed the gate at midnight.
column6: walking a fixed round to keep watch – 沿固定路线走动查看
column8: 两名值守者沿围墙走同一条路线，手电扫过角落

column2: 中古英语 patroun ← 古法语 patron ← 拉丁语 patrōnus（保护人），源自 pater（父亲）
column3: a person who gives money to support an activity, or a regular customer
column5: A wealthy patron funded the whole exhibition.|Regular patrons get a small discount.
column6: one who stands over something as protector – 像父辈那样护持某事的人
column7: 赞助人：出钱护持某项事业的人|顾客：常来照顾生意的人
column8: 出资者站在画作旁，铜牌上刻着他的名字

column2: 早期作 patten／paterne，来自中古英语 patron（样板）← 古法语 patron ← 中世纪拉丁语 patrōnus
column3: a repeated arrangement, or a model to be copied
column5: The tiles form a simple repeating pattern.|Her sleep pattern changed after the move.
column6: an arrangement that repeats or serves as a model – 反复出现或供照做的排布
column7: 模式：反复出现的固定样式|图案：布面或器物上的花样排布
column8: 布面上同一组花样每隔一段就重复一次

column2: 中古英语 pament ← 盎格鲁诺曼语 pavement ← 拉丁语 pavīmentum（夯实的地面），源自 pavīre（夯、踏实）
column3: a paved path at the side of a road
column5: They walked along the narrow pavement.|Rain pooled on the uneven pavement.
column6: a beaten flat surface for walking – 夯平铺硬供人走的面
column8: 街边铺着方砖的窄条，与车道之间有一道石沿

column2: 由 pea（豌豆）＋ nut（坚果）复合而成，可能是 pinda 一词的俗解
column3: a small oily seed that grows in a shell underground
column5: He shelled peanuts while watching the game.|This sauce contains crushed peanuts.
column6: an underground seed in a brittle shell – 长在地下、外裹脆壳的籽实
column8: 带纹路的浅褐硬壳一掰两半，里面躺着两粒红皮仁

column2: 中古英语 paissaunt ← 盎格鲁诺曼语 paisant ← 古法语 païsan（乡下人），源自 païs（地方）← 拉丁语 pāgus（乡野）
column3: a poor farmer who works a small piece of land
column5: Peasants carried grain to the market.|A peasant family farmed this hillside.
column6: a poor worker of the countryside – 乡野间耕作的贫苦人
column8: 粗布衣的人弯腰在田垄间除草，草帽压得很低

column2: 中古英语 pibel ← 古英语 papolstān（卵石），前一半 *papol 来源不明
column3: a small smooth stone found on a beach or riverbed
column5: She picked up a smooth grey pebble.|Pebbles crunched under our heavy boots.
column6: a small stone rounded by water – 被水磨圆的小石
column8: 河床上一层圆滑的小石子，被水冲得没有棱角

column2: 拉丁语 pecūliāris（属于私产的）← pecūlium（私产）← pecus（牲畜）
column3: strange or unusual, or belonging only to one thing
column5: There was a peculiar smell in the hall.|This custom is peculiar to that village.
column6: set apart from all the rest – 与其余明显分开的
column7: 奇怪的：与常见的明显不同|独有的：只属于某一方而非旁的
column8: 一排相同的杯子里有一只形状明显不同，被单独摆出

column2: 盎格鲁诺曼语与古法语 pincil（细画笔）← 拉丁语 pēnicillum，为 pēniculus（小刷）的指小形
column3: a thin stick used for writing or drawing
column5: He sharpened his pencil before the test.|Draw the line in pencil first.
column6: a thin stick that leaves a grey mark – 能留下灰痕的细杆
column8: 木杆中央嵌着灰黑细芯，一端削出锥形尖

column2: 拉丁语 penētrātus，为 penētrō（置于内、刺入）的过去分词，与 penes（在内）有关
column3: to go into or through something
column5: The needle penetrated the thick fabric.|Light barely penetrates the dense canopy.
column6: to get inside and pass through – 进到里面并穿过去
column7: 穿透：从一面贯穿到另一面|渗入：慢慢进到内部
column8: 钉尖穿过木板从另一面露出一截

column2: 中古英语 puple ← 盎格鲁诺曼语 people ← 古法语 pueple ← 拉丁语 populus（民众）
column3: human beings in general, or the members of a nation
column5: Many people waited outside the hall.|The people chose a new leader.
column6: human beings taken together – 合起来看的众人
column7: 人们：泛指许多人|民族：同属一国或一族的全体
column8: 广场上密密站着许多身影，衣着各不相同

column2: 古英语 piper ← 拉丁语 piper ← 希腊语 peperi，更早来自印度语言（梵语 pippali 长胡椒）
column3: a hot-tasting powder made from dried berries
column5: She added salt and pepper to the soup.|Black pepper grows on climbing vines.
column6: a pungent spice ground from dried berries – 干果磨成的辛辣香料
column8: 小磨旋转，深色颗粒碎成粉末落在菜面上

column2: 拉丁语 per（穿过、在…期间）← 原始印欧语 *per
column3: for each one of something
column5: The rate is ten pounds per hour.|Output rose per worker this quarter.
column6: taken for each single unit – 按每一个单位计
column7: 每：按单个计算|每一：逐个地分摊到各个
column8: 价目牌上写着单位重量与对应的一个数字

column2: 由 percent ＋ -age 构成；percent ← 拉丁语 per centum（每一百）
column3: an amount expressed as a part of one hundred
column5: A small percentage of seeds never sprout.|The percentage rose by three points.
column6: a share reckoned against one hundred – 以一百为底算出的份额
column8: 圆饼被分成一百小格，其中一块被涂上颜色

column2: 借自中古法语 parfum／perfum（熏香）
column3: a liquid with a sweet smell worn on the skin, or a pleasant smell
column5: She wore a light perfume that evening.|The perfume of cut grass filled the yard.
column6: a scent carried through the air – 在空气里散开的气味
column7: 香水：涂在身上的芳香液体|香味：好闻的气味本身
column8: 小玻璃瓶按下喷头，细雾散开后气味留在手腕

column2: 中古英语 perhappes，由 per-（凭）＋ hap（机遇）＋ -s 构成，仿 perchance 而成
column3: used to say that something is possible but not certain
column5: Perhaps she forgot about the meeting.|We could leave early, perhaps at noon.
column6: possible as it may chance – 也许如此，凭机遇而定
column8: 说话的人摊开手，眉头一动没有给出定论

column2: 中古英语 periode ← 中古法语 periode ← 中世纪拉丁语 periodus ← 希腊语 periodos（绕行一周），由 peri-（环绕）＋ hodos（路）构成
column3: a length of time, or the dot ending a sentence
column5: The building stood empty for a long period.|Add a period at the end.
column6: a stretch that comes round and closes – 走完一圈合上的一段
column7: 时期：有起止的一段时间|句号：把句子合上的那个点
column8: 时间轴上一段被两条竖线夹出，末端点着一个小圆点

column2: 由 period ＋ -ical 构成
column3: a magazine that comes out at regular intervals
column5: The library keeps back issues of each periodical.|She subscribes to two scientific periodicals.
column6: something appearing at regular intervals – 按固定间隔出现的
column7: 期刊：按期出版的刊物|周期性的：每隔固定时段就出现一次
column8: 书架上同一刊名的册子按月份排开，封面只改期号

column2: 拉丁语 permeātus，为 permeō（穿行而过）的过去分词，由 per-（穿过）＋ meāre（行走）构成
column3: to spread through every part of something
column5: The smell permeated the entire building.|New ideas permeated the whole department.
column6: to pass right through every part – 穿行进每一处
column7: 渗透：一点点进入并布满内部|弥漫：气味或气氛充满整个空间
column8: 一滴墨落进清水，颜色慢慢铺满整个杯子
